results.headline: Taiwan parliament passes its own drone plan and backs $7bn boost for domestic builders

results.headline: Trump chip tariff plan could cost $90bn in annual GDP and delay one-fifth of US data centre projects, industry warns

results.headline: Zambia opposition leader detained on treason charges ahead of president's inauguration

results.headline: Japan's births rise for first time in 11 years
results.reason: summary: gives specific figures ('731,000 babies born, a 1.8 percent increase') and attributes the rise to 'a post-pandemic rebound in marriages', none of which appear in the only cited source's available text (A289's summary is just the headline restated, with no such details); why_it_matters also asserts 'defence spending and social costs are also rising' with no support in the single cited source.
